scope: Dated source-review comparison against the existing 20-layer baseline. No runtime replacement, universal quality ranking or target-PC acceptance.

integrated_claude_inputs.scope: Published native workflow practice and usage evidence

live_claude.boundary: Both independent source reports are sealed and coordinator-adjudicated. The peer is running its planned coverage synthesis; that final return is not yet present. No reviewer vote changes runtime qualification.

blinding: Both reviews have residual exposure to ambient project/tool names. Codex reports no catalog-artifact, memory or other-review access before freezing. Claude project instructions can name current domain selections. No zero-bias or superiority claim.

layers.rationale: Native Codex/Claude match both the installed evidence and the independent interface-fit recommendation. Aider is newly indexed as a provider-flexible alternative; no equivalent account/recovery trial establishes a replacement.
layers.claude_independent_finding: Retain Codex/Claude. Claude Code was wrongly excluded by the mechanical license check despite explicit commercial terms. Star-capped rankings and mixed benchmark/model results do not establish a better native-client replacement.
layers.comparison_rule: Use the canonical layer overturn_when and the independent report's test_that_would_change_choice; adjudicate omissions without treating them as failed candidates.
